award.quote: Award Budget Award budgets are composed of salary and other program-related expenses, as described below. Award Project Period The total project period may not exceed 5 years.

sections.name: Candidate's Background
sections.component: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form: Candidate Information and Goals for Career Development
sections.quote: Candidate's Background Describe the candidate's commitment to an academic career in Patient-Oriented Research (POR).

sections.name: Career Goals and Objectives
sections.component: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form: Candidate Information and Goals for Career Development
sections.quote: Career Goals and Objectives Describe a systematic plan: (1) that shows a logical progression from prior research and training experiences to the research and career development experiences

sections.name: Candidate's Plan for Career Development/Training Activities During Award Period
sections.component: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form: Candidate Information and Goals for Career Development
sections.quote: Candidate's Plan for Career Development/Training Activities During Award Period The candidate and the mentor(s) are jointly responsible for the preparation of the career development plan.

sections.name: Research Strategy
sections.component: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form: Research Plan
sections.quote: Research Strategy A sound research project that is consistent with the candidate's level of research development and objectives of their career development plan must be provided.

sections.name: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research
sections.component: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form: Research Plan
sections.quote: All applications must include a plan to fulfill NIH requirements for instruction in the Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR).

sections.name: Plans and Statements of Mentor and Co-mentor(s)
sections.component: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form: Mentor, Co-Mentor, Consultant, Collaborators
sections.quote: The application must include a statement from the mentor providing: 1) information on his/her research qualifications and previous experience as a research supervisor;

sections.name: Description of Institutional Environment
sections.component: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form: Environment & Institutional Commitment to the Candidate
sections.quote: Description of Institutional Environment The sponsoring institution must document a strong, well-established research and career development program related to the candidate's area of interest

sections.name: Data Management and Sharing Plan
sections.conditional: Research that will generate scientific data
sections.component: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form: Other Plan(s)
sections.quote: A Data Management and Sharing Plan (DMS Plan) is required for any NIH-funded or conducted research that will generate scientific data. Applicants must submit the DMS Plan at the time of application using the NIH DMS Plan Format Page.

criteria.name: Overall Impact
criteria.quote: Reviewers should provide their assessment of the likelihood that the proposed career development and research plan will enhance the candidate's potential for a productive, independent scientific research career

criteria.name: Candidate
criteria.quote: Candidate Does the candidate have the potential to develop as an independent and productive researcher?

criteria.name: Career Development Plan/Career Goals and Objectives/Plan to Provide Mentoring
sections: Candidate's Plan for Career Development/Training Activities During Award Period
Plans and Statements of Mentor and Co-mentor(s)
criteria.quote: Career Development Plan/Career Goals and Objectives/Plan to Provide Mentoring What is the likelihood that the plan will contribute substantially to the scientific development of the candidate

criteria.name: Research Plan
criteria.quote: Research Plan Are the proposed research question, design, and methodology of significant scientific and technical merit?

criteria.name: Mentor(s), Co-Mentor(s), Consultant(s), Collaborator(s)
sections: Plans and Statements of Mentor and Co-mentor(s)
criteria.quote: Mentor(s), Co-Mentor(s), Consultant(s), Collaborator(s) Are the qualifications of the mentor(s) in the area of the proposed research appropriate?

criteria.name: Environment & Institutional Commitment to the Candidate
criteria.quote: Environment & Institutional Commitment to the Candidate Is there clear commitment of the sponsoring institution to ensure that the required minimum of the candidate's effort will be devoted directly to the research

criteria.name: Study Timeline for Clinical Trials
criteria.quote: Study Timeline for Clinical Trials Is the study timeline described in detail, taking into account start-up activities, the anticipated rate of enrollment, and planned follow-up assessment?

criteria.name: Protections for Human Subjects
criteria.quote: For research that involves human subjects but does not involve one of the categories of research that are exempt under 45 CFR Part 46, the committee will evaluate the justification for involvement of human subjects

criteria.name: Inclusion of Women, Racial and Ethnic Minorities, and Individuals Across the Lifespan
criteria.quote: When the proposed project involves human subjects and/or NIH-defined clinical research, the committee will evaluate the proposed plans for the inclusion (or exclusion) of individuals on the basis of sex, race, and ethnicity

criteria.name: Vertebrate Animals
criteria.quote: The committee will evaluate the involvement of live vertebrate animals as part of the scientific assessment according to the following three points:

criteria.name: Biohazards
criteria.quote: Reviewers will assess whether materials or procedures proposed are potentially hazardous to research personnel and/or the environment, and if needed, determine whether adequate protection is proposed.

criteria.name: Resubmissions
criteria.quote: For Resubmissions, the committee will evaluate the application as now presented, taking into consideration the responses to comments from the previous scientific review group and changes made to the project.

criteria.name: Revisions
criteria.quote: For Revisions, the committee will consider the appropriateness of the proposed expansion of the scope of the project.

criteria.name: Resource Sharing Plans
criteria.quote: Reviewers will comment on whether the Resource Sharing Plan(s) (i.e., Sharing Model Organisms

criteria.name: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research
sections: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research
criteria.quote: the reviewers will evaluate the adequacy of the proposed RCR training in relation to the following five required components: 1) Format - the required format of instruction

criteria.name: Select Agent Research
criteria.quote: Reviewers will assess the information provided in this section of the application, including 1) the Select Agent(s) to be used in the proposed research

criteria.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
criteria.quote: For projects involving key biological and/or chemical resources, reviewers will comment on the brief plans proposed for identifying and ensuring the validity of those resources.

criteria.name: Budget and Period of Support
criteria.quote: Reviewers will consider whether the budget and the requested period of support are fully justified and reasonable in relation to the proposed research.

eligibility.item: Eligible organizations: public/state and private institutions of higher education; nonprofits with or without 501(c)(3) status; for-profit organizations including small businesses; state, county, city/township and special district governments; federally recognized and other Indian/Native American tribal governments; federal governments; U.S. territories; independent school districts; public/Indian housing authorities; Native American tribal organizations; faith-based or community-based organizations; regional organizations
eligibility.quote: Eligible Organizations Higher Education Institutions Public/State Controlled Institutions of Higher Education Private Institutions of Higher Education Nonprofits Other Than Institutions of Higher Education

eligibility.item: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) entities and non-domestic components of U.S. organizations are not eligible; foreign components are allowed
eligibility.quote: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) Entities (Foreign Organizations) are not eligible to apply. Non-domestic (non-U.S.) components of U.S. Organizations are not eligible to apply.

eligibility.item: Applications involving foreign subawards/subcontracts are noncompliant and will not be considered
eligibility.quote: Applications involving foreign subawards/subcontracts submitted in response to this NOFO will be deemed noncompliant and will not be considered for funding.

eligibility.item: Must propose an independent clinical trial (or clinical trial feasibility study or separate ancillary trial) led by the candidate; otherwise apply to companion PA-24-185
eligibility.quote: Required: Only accepting applications that propose an independent clinical trial(s).

eligibility.item: Applications must fall within the mission of a participating Institute/Center; non-participating ICs will not consider applications
eligibility.quote: ICs that do not participate in this announcement will not consider applications for funding.

eligibility.item: Only New, Resubmission and Revision application types are allowed
eligibility.quote: Application Types Allowed New Resubmission Revision

eligibility.item: Organization must complete all registrations (SAM with annual renewal, UEI, eRA Commons, Grants.gov) before submission; allow 6 weeks or more
eligibility.quote: All registrations must be completed prior to the application being submitted. Registration can take 6 weeks or more, so applicants should begin the registration process as soon as possible.

eligibility.item: Use the same UEI for all registrations, on the application and in the eRA Commons profile
eligibility.quote: The same UEI must be used for all registrations, as well as on the grant application.

eligibility.item: eRA Commons registration requires at least one Signing Official and one PD/PI account
eligibility.quote: eRA Commons requires organizations to identify at least one Signing Official (SO) and at least one Program Director/Principal Investigator (PD/PI) account in order to submit an application.

eligibility.item: PD/PI must have an eRA Commons account affiliated with the applicant organization (two distinct accounts if also the Signing Official)
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must have an eRA Commons account. PD(s)/PI(s) should work with their organizational officials to either create a new account or to affiliate their existing account

eligibility.item: PD/PI must be registered with ORCID and linked to the eRA Commons personal profile
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must be registered with ORCID (https://orcid.org/). The personal profile associated with the PD(s)/PI(s) eRA Commons account must be linked to a valid ORCID ID.

eligibility.item: PD/PI must enter their eRA Commons ID in the Credential field of the Senior/Key Person Profile form
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must include their eRA Commons ID in the Credential field of the Senior/Key Person Profile form.

eligibility.item: Multiple PDs/PIs are not allowed
eligibility.quote: Multiple PDs/PIs are not allowed.

eligibility.item: By time of award, candidate must be a U.S. citizen, non-citizen national, or lawful permanent resident
eligibility.quote: By the time of award, the individual must be a citizen or a non-citizen national of the United States or have been lawfully admitted for permanent residence

eligibility.item: Current and former PDs/PIs of R01, P01, P50, other major individual K awards (e.g., K01, K07, K08, K22, K23, K25, K76, K99/R00) or equivalent are not eligible; R03, R21/R33, R34/U34, R36, SBIR/STTR, K38, K12 and KL2 remain eligible
eligibility.quote: Current and former PDs/PIs on NIH research project (R01), program project (P01), center grants (P50), Project Leads of program project (P01), or center grants (P50), other major individual career development awards

eligibility.item: Candidate must have a health-professional doctoral degree or a PhD/doctorate in a clinical discipline
eligibility.quote: Candidates for the K23 award must have a health-professional doctoral degree. Such degrees include, but are not limited to, the MD, DO, DDS, DMD, OD, DC, PharmD, ND (Doctor of Naturopathy)

eligibility.item: Candidate must complete clinical training (including specialty/subspecialty) before award, but may apply before completing it
eligibility.quote: Candidates also must have completed their clinical training, including specialty and, if applicable, subspecialty training prior to receiving an award. However, candidates may submit an application prior to the completion of clinical training.

eligibility.item: Candidate must hold a full-time appointment at the academic institution at the time of award
eligibility.quote: At the time of award, the candidate must have a "full-time" appointment at the academic institution.

eligibility.item: Candidate must commit at least 75% of full-time professional effort (9 person-months) to career development
eligibility.quote: Candidates are required to commit a minimum of 75% of full-time professional effort (i.e., a minimum of 9 person-months) to their program of career development.

eligibility.item: VA appointment effort cannot count toward the full-time requirement; VA-appointed candidates should contact IC staff before applying
eligibility.quote: Candidates who have VA appointments may not consider part of the VA effort toward satisfying the full time requirement at the applicant institution.

eligibility.item: Candidate must identify a mentor (one primary mentor if a team) before submitting
eligibility.quote: Before submitting the application, the candidate must identify a mentor who will supervise the proposed career development and research experience.

eligibility.item: Applicant institution must have a strong, well-established record of research and career development activities and qualified mentors
eligibility.quote: The applicant institution must have a strong, well-established record of research and career development activities and faculty qualified to serve as mentors in biomedical, behavioral, or clinical research.

eligibility.item: Organizations may submit more than one application only if each is scientifically distinct and from a different candidate
eligibility.quote: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided that each application is scientifically distinct, and each is from a different candidate.

eligibility.item: An individual may not have two or more competing NIH career development applications pending review concurrently
eligibility.quote: An individual may not have two or more competing NIH career development applications pending review concurrently.

eligibility.item: A new (A0) application is not accepted before the summary statement issues for an overlapping A0 or A1 application
eligibility.quote: A new (A0) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the review of an overlapping new (A0) or resubmission (A1) application.

eligibility.item: A resubmission (A1) is not accepted before the summary statement issues for the previous A0 application
eligibility.quote: A resubmission (A1) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the review of the previous new (A0) application.

eligibility.item: An application substantially overlapping another application pending appeal of initial peer review is not accepted
eligibility.quote: An application that has substantial overlap with another application pending appeal of initial peer review.

eligibility.item: Concurrent research project grant applications may not substantially overlap the career award application scientifically or budgetarily
eligibility.quote: Candidates may submit research project grant (RPG) applications concurrently with the K application. However, any concurrent RPG application may not have substantial scientific and/or budgetary overlap with the career award application.

eligibility.item: Applications lacking the required reference letters will not be reviewed
eligibility.quote: Applications lacking the appropriate required reference letters will not be reviewed.

requiredDocuments.item: Signed letters of support from all collaborators and/or consultants confirming participation and describing their roles
requiredDocuments.quote: Signed statements must be provided by all collaborators and/or consultants confirming their participation in the project and describing their specific roles.

requiredDocuments.item: Signed statements from each advisory committee member (if applicable)
requiredDocuments.quote: Advisory committee members (if applicable): Signed statements must be provided by each member of the proposed advisory committee.

requiredDocuments.item: Institutional Commitment to the Candidate's Research Career Development statement from the sponsoring institution
requiredDocuments.quote: The sponsoring institution must provide a statement of commitment to the candidate's development into a productive, independent investigator and to meeting the requirements of this award.

requiredDocuments.item: Letter of agreement from the CTSA PD/PI (if using CTSA resources)
requiredDocuments.quote: Candidates who will be using resources associated with a Clinical and Translational Science Award (CTSA) during the course of their career development award should include a letter of agreement from the CTSA PD/PI

requiredDocuments.item: At least one human subjects study record (PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information) or Delayed Onset Study record if human subjects are involved
requiredDocuments.quote: you must include at least one human subjects study record using the Study Record: PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information form or Delayed Onset Study record.
PHS Assignment Request Form All instructions in the How to Apply - Application uide

requiredDocuments.item: Reference letters, submitted by referees through eRA Commons
requiredDocuments.quote: Reference letters are submitted directly through the eRA Commons Submit Referee Information link and not through Grants.gov.
